name: read_script
title: read_script
description: Reads a GDScript file and returns its source plus an index of every function and the line it starts on. Read before you patch: patch_script's replace_function needs a name that exists, and replace_text needs the text to match byte for byte including indentation. For a long file, use from_line/to_line to pull just the region you care about instead of spending context on the whole thing — the function index comes back regardless of the window, so you can locate a function and then fetch only it.

node.description: Alternative to 'path': read whatever script is attached to this node in the open scene.

to_line.description: Last line to return (inclusive). Omit for end of file.

source.description: The requested window of the file.

line_count.description: Total lines in the file, not just the window.

functions.description: Every function in the whole file, regardless of the window.

errors.no_script: That node has no script attached.
errors.built_in_script: That node's script is embedded in the scene, not a file on disk.
